correctness.rationale: For W=0^a1^b0^c1^d0^c1^b0^a with strictly positive a,b,c,d, good forbids factors u complement(u) of half-length>=2 (order-one allowed). The order-two four forbidden words force each adjacent run pair to include a singleton and no interior run of length 2, and order-three alternating antisquare excludes b=c=d=1. Consequently exactly three disjoint families survive the short filters. The imported complete minimal-antisquare classification of Baranwal et al Theorem 11 reduces all longer obstructions to rotations of 0^k101^k01 for k>=3. In family 1 all zero-runs are singleton, in family 2 all one-runs are singleton, excluding longer rotations. In family 3 the unique long 1-run must be central and a cyclic rotation fits iff d<=2a (the split long zero-run draws from two outer blocks), yielding sharp d>2a. GF follows bijective run lengths: 2*( z^10(z+z³/(1-z))/(1-z²)+z^11/(1-z²)^2+z^9/((1-z)(1-z^4)) ). Independently enumerated every quadruple 1<=a,b,c,d<=7 (2401) with literal antisquare checks; exact match. Full all-parameter proof uses imported theorem, not finite test.
